question: author, 2026-11-08: out-of-the-box ways to build homes at low cost and fast

factory_20.label: Factory building: 20% fewer hours per m2

factory_35.label: Factory building: 35% fewer hours per m2

self_build_50.label: Households build half of the extension above 15 m2 (supervised, materials supplied)

self_build_65.label: Households build 65% of the extension (mutual self-help practice)

decent_core_first.label: Decent core (15 m2) for everyone first

growth_15_record_1_5x.label: Capacity +15%/yr and build rate up to 1.5x the China 2011 record (SYNTHETIC)

all.label: All levers: factory 20%, households build half of the extension, +15%/yr, 1.5x record

evidence.labour_multiplier: McKinsey 2019 (via Construction Dive 24 Jun 2019, secondary, VERIFIED text): modular 20-50% faster, cost savings up to 20%, risk of 10% loss; applied to hours per m2 as 0.8 / 0.65 SYNTHETIC
evidence.self_build_share: USDA mutual self-help housing: families provide at least 65% of labour (RCAC, REPORTED, page refused fetch); applied to the increment above 15 m2 only; household hours are counted separately
evidence.sites_and_services: Michaels et al. 2017 (LSE SERC DP222, VERIFIED abstract): de novo sites-and-services neighbourhoods in seven Tanzanian cities developed better housing than control areas (larger footprints, more storeys, water, electricity, sanitation, roads); upgrading areas if anything worse
evidence.reuse: Japan 2023 Housing and Land Survey: 9.0 m vacant, 13.8% (Jiji/Kyodo, REPORTED); EU 2023: 33.3% in under-occupied homes (Eurostat housing 2024, VERIFIED); India urban vacant 11.1 m (v70): ~0.5% of the need in deficit regions
evidence.record_1_5x: SYNTHETIC: factory production could exceed the China 2011 site-built record; no observation supports it
evidence.3d_printing: no independently audited whole-project cost or schedule figures found (prototype and print-time claims only); not used as a lever

reading: the date is set by how fast building capacity grows and by the record build rate, not by cost; factory building and household self-build cut the professional workforce needed at the peak, which is the binding limit found in v70 (240-265 m workers against 116 m in South Asia and Africa)
limits: labour hours per m2 for self-built extensions unknown (set equal to professional hours)
self-build needs a core designed for extension, land tenure, supervision and materials logistics
the model has one world capacity; regional bottlenecks (cement, skilled trades) are not represented
the 1.5x record case has no observational support and is shown only to test whether the cap binds
